message.content: {"count":3,"rationale":"Block browserStore:credentialAccess, backupHost:lateralMovement, and tokenCache:credentialAccess. These disable all four parents of the target: shareMount, vaultRead, dbReplica, and codeRepo. At least three blocks are necessary because three attack derivations have disjoint blockable steps: (1) phishing → browserStore → appServer → codeRepo; (2) vpnGateway → tokenCache → printServer → shareMount; (3) supplychain → both iotDevice and memoryDump → ssoLogin → backupHost, together with exposedApi → sshKey → jumpHost, enabling secretsManager → vaultRead. Each derivation reaches the target and requires a separate block."}
